blocks.x: A no-theater description of Education & Research: what ships first, what it touches at LMS & learning stores, how it is verified, and the per cohort metric we commit to moving against baseline.

Education institutions run two businesses on one budget: teaching and knowledge production. Both are being reshaped by AI — adaptive learning and assessment automation on one side, research acceleration from literature synthesis to simulation on the other — while both face an integrity crisis that generic tooling makes worse. The institutions that thrive will industrialize the boring (operations, admissions, estate management) to fund the essential (teaching quality, research depth).

blocks.title: Decision fabric — how Achala IT Solutions composes Education & Research capability
blocks.note: Signals, context and policy converge at the decision layer; every scored decision is logged with its inputs so it can be replayed at audit.

blocks.x: The constraints are real: student-privacy regimes (FERPA/GDPR-K class), accessibility mandates, academic-integrity governance, research-data ethics, and budget cycles that punish stranded investments. Technology must respect pedagogy and governance, not bulldoze them — which is why Achala IT Solutions co-designs every deployment with faculty governance and student bodies.
